features.name: Search objects and boxes by label
features.match_note: Items are found by name and tag; search returning places by their own tags is not stated.

features.name: Photograph a box's contents to log them
features.match_note: Photo-first logging, with items proposed from the photo.

features.name: Mark each object on the box photo
features.match_note: Regions on a place photo point to items, and a photo splits into items; no cut-out images.

features.name: Give objects free-text labels
features.match_note: Any number of tags per item, with a tag tree on top.

features.name: Rename a label
features.match_note: Renaming is implied for module tags only (R151); no rule defines renaming tags in general.

features.name: Number and label boxes
features.match_note: Places carry a name and tags; a number is a naming choice.

features.name: Move an object to another box
features.match_note: Move and bulk move are in stage 3.

features.name: Re-photograph an object
features.match_note: Items can be rephotographed; a new photo clears the outdated flag.

features.name: Delete an object or a label
features.match_note: Deleting an item is mentioned only in passing (R143); deleting a tag is not defined.

features.name: See labels ranked by use
features.match_note: The tag card shows top-level tags; no ranking by use.

features.name: Back up data
features.match_note: Automatic backup to a chosen folder and manual export.
